item.title: Slash Commands 0.8.0
item.description:
## What's New in 0.8.0
### Command Expansion - Added slash command expansion with `Tab` or `Space` in approved macOS apps. - Added exact trigger matching with bounded replacement so only the command token before the caret is replaced. - Added support for multi-line command bodies and reusable variables such as `{{ name }}`.
### Setup and Settings - Added a first-run setup flow for required macOS permissions. - Added command management with autosave, duplicate trigger protection, and delete confirmation. - Added app targeting controls for All Apps and Selected Apps modes. - Added launch-at-login settings so Slash Commands can be available after sign-in.
### Updates - Added in-app update checks and stable release delivery through Sparkle. - Added update preferences for automatic checks and automatic downloads.
